context: Late evening at a small Tokyo intersection. An elderly visitor sits on a bench looking confused. Officer Takeda steps over from his bicycle.
purpose: tiny help across regions — careful officer, slightly tipsy elder, Tokyo at night

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: こんばんは。大丈夫ですか？
lines.style: Low, calm, professional. Crouches a half-step at the bench.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: ああ…ちょっと、迷ってしもうて。
lines.style: Slow Tohoku honesty with a small slurred edge.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.style: Plain question, no judgment in the voice.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 岩手や。今、息子の家、来とるんやけど。
lines.en: Iwate. But — visiting my son's place now.
lines.style: A small admission. The visiting-elder honesty.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: なるほど。一緒に、お時間少しいただければ。
lines.en: I see. If I can have a moment of your time, together.
lines.style: A small kind formality. Already pulling out his phone.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.style: A small genuine apology. Voice slightly lower.
